languages.name: Java
languages.description: Master Java from your first Hello World to JVM tuning and cloud-native architecture. Covers JDK 21 LTS features including virtual threads, records, pattern matching, and the modern Spring ecosystem.

sections.title: Beginner
sections.description: Foundations — start here with zero prior experience

topics.title: What is Java?
topics.description: History, platform independence, JVM/JRE/JDK explained, and where Java is used today (Android, enterprise, cloud, big data).

topics.title: Setting Up Your Environment
topics.description: Install JDK 21 LTS, configure JAVA_HOME, choose an IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, VS Code, Eclipse), and run your first program.

topics.title: Hello World & Program Structure
topics.description: main method, class structure, compilation (javac) vs execution (java), and understanding the entry point.

topics.title: Variables & Data Types
topics.description: Primitive types (int, double, boolean, char), reference types, var keyword (local type inference), literals, and type casting.

topics.title: Operators & Expressions
topics.description: Arithmetic, relational, logical, bitwise, assignment, ternary operator, and operator precedence.

topics.title: Control Flow
topics.description: if/else, switch statements and switch expressions (Java 14+), and best practices for branching logic.

topics.title: Loops
topics.description: for, enhanced for-each, while, do-while loops, break/continue, and nested loops.

topics.title: Arrays
topics.description: Single and multi-dimensional arrays, array initialization, common operations, and Arrays utility class.

topics.title: Strings & Text
topics.description: String immutability, StringBuilder/StringBuffer, text blocks (Java 15+), formatting, and common String methods.

topics.title: Methods & Functions
topics.description: Method declaration, parameters, return types, method overloading, varargs, and pass-by-value semantics.

topics.title: Basic Input & Output
topics.description: Scanner class, System.out formatting, reading user input, and basic console-based programs.

topics.title: Comments & Documentation
topics.description: Single-line, multi-line, and Javadoc comments. Writing self-documenting code.

topics.title: Introduction to OOP
topics.description: Classes, objects, fields, methods, constructors, this keyword, and the four pillars of OOP.

topics.title: Encapsulation & Access Modifiers
topics.description: private, public, protected, default access. Getters/setters, immutability, and data hiding.

topics.title: Inheritance
topics.description: extends keyword, method overriding, super keyword, Object class, and composition vs inheritance.

topics.title: Polymorphism
topics.description: Runtime polymorphism, upcasting/downcasting, instanceof operator, and dynamic method dispatch.

topics.title: Abstraction
topics.description: Abstract classes vs interfaces, default and static interface methods, and designing clean APIs.

topics.title: Interfaces & Functional Interfaces
topics.description: Interface contracts, multiple inheritance via interfaces, sealed interfaces (Java 17+), and @FunctionalInterface.

topics.title: Enums
topics.description: Type-safe constants, enum methods, enum with fields/constructors, and EnumSet/EnumMap.

topics.title: Exception Handling
topics.description: try/catch/finally, checked vs unchecked exceptions, custom exceptions, try-with-resources, and best practices.

topics.title: Collections Framework
topics.description: List, Set, Map, Queue interfaces. ArrayList, LinkedList, HashSet, TreeSet, HashMap, TreeMap, and choosing the right collection.

topics.title: Generics Basics
topics.description: Generic classes, methods, bounded type parameters, wildcards (? extends, ? super), and type erasure.

topics.title: File I/O
topics.description: File class, reading/writing with BufferedReader/Writer, NIO.2 Path and Files API, and serialization basics.

topics.title: Date & Time API
topics.description: java.time package: LocalDate, LocalTime, LocalDateTime, ZonedDateTime, Duration, Period, and DateTimeFormatter.

topics.title: Packages & Module Basics
topics.description: Package declaration, imports, classpath, JAR files, and introduction to the Java Platform Module System (JPMS).

topics.title: Static, Nested & Inner Classes
topics.description: Static members, static blocks, inner classes, anonymous classes, and local classes.

topics.title: Unit Testing with JUnit 5
topics.description: Writing test cases, assertions, @BeforeEach/@AfterEach, parameterized tests, and test-driven development basics.

sections.title: Advanced
sections.description: Modern features — master the Java ecosystem

topics.title: Lambda Expressions
topics.description: Functional programming in Java, lambda syntax, variable capture, and when to use lambdas over anonymous classes.

topics.title: Stream API
topics.description: Intermediate and terminal operations, map/filter/reduce, collectors, parallel streams, and primitive streams.

topics.title: Optional & Null Safety
topics.description: Avoiding NullPointerException, Optional creation and chaining, orElse/orElseGet, and anti-patterns to avoid.

topics.title: Records
topics.description: Compact data carriers, canonical constructors, record patterns, and when to use records vs classes.

topics.title: Sealed Classes & Interfaces
topics.description: Restricting inheritance hierarchies, permits clause, pattern matching integration, and domain modeling.

topics.title: Pattern Matching
topics.description: instanceof patterns, switch patterns (Java 21), record patterns, and guarded patterns for exhaustive handling.

topics.title: Concurrency Fundamentals
topics.description: Threads, Runnable/Callable, ExecutorService, synchronized, volatile, atomic classes, and thread safety.

topics.title: Virtual Threads (Project Loom)
topics.description: Lightweight threads, Thread.ofVirtual(), structured concurrency, and when to prefer virtual over platform threads.

topics.title: CompletableFuture & Async Programming
topics.description: Asynchronous pipelines, thenApply/thenCompose, combining futures, and error handling in async code.

topics.title: JDBC & Database Access
topics.description: Connecting to databases, PreparedStatement, connection pooling (HikariCP), transactions, and JPA introduction.

topics.title: Logging Frameworks
topics.description: SLF4J facade, Logback configuration, log levels, structured logging, and MDC for request tracing.

topics.title: Maven & Gradle
topics.description: Project structure, dependencies, lifecycle phases, plugins, multi-module projects, and dependency management.

topics.title: Spring Boot Fundamentals
topics.description: Dependency injection, @RestController, Spring Data JPA, configuration properties, and building REST APIs.

topics.title: REST API Design
topics.description: HTTP methods, status codes, request/response DTOs, validation, exception handlers, and OpenAPI/Swagger.

topics.title: Reactive Programming
topics.description: Project Reactor, Mono/Flux, backpressure, WebFlux, and when reactive vs imperative is the right choice.

sections.title: Expert
sections.description: Deep mastery — JVM internals, architecture & performance

topics.title: JVM Architecture & Internals
topics.description: Class loading, bytecode, method area, heap structure, stack frames, and the execution engine.

topics.title: Garbage Collection Tuning
topics.description: GC algorithms (G1, ZGC, Shenandoah), GC logs analysis, heap sizing, and choosing the right collector for your workload.

topics.title: Memory Management & Leaks
topics.description: Heap vs stack, off-heap memory, memory leak detection with profilers, and weak/soft/phantom references.

topics.title: JVM Performance Optimization
topics.description: JIT compilation, escape analysis, inlining, profiling with JFR/async-profiler, and microbenchmarking with JMH.

topics.title: Design Patterns in Java
topics.description: Creational, structural, and behavioral patterns. Singleton, Factory, Builder, Observer, Strategy, and anti-patterns.

topics.title: SOLID & Clean Architecture
topics.description: Single responsibility, open/closed, Liskov substitution, interface segregation, dependency inversion, and hexagonal architecture.

topics.title: Microservices Architecture
topics.description: Service decomposition, API gateways, service discovery, circuit breakers, distributed tracing, and event-driven design.

topics.title: Spring Advanced Topics
topics.description: Custom auto-configuration, AOP, Spring Security OAuth2, Spring Cloud, and production-ready configurations.

topics.title: Advanced Testing Strategies
topics.description: Integration testing with Testcontainers, contract testing (Pact), mutation testing, and test architecture.

topics.title: Java Security Best Practices
topics.description: OWASP Top 10, input validation, secure coding, cryptography (JCA), JWT, and secrets management.

topics.title: Foreign Function & Memory API
topics.description: Project Panama — calling native code, MemorySegment, Arena, and replacing JNI for high-performance interop.

topics.title: GraalVM & Native Image
topics.description: Ahead-of-time compilation, faster startup, lower memory footprint, and building cloud-native Java applications.

topics.title: Structured Concurrency & Scoped Values
topics.description: StructuredTaskScope, scoped values for implicit context propagation, and modern concurrent API design.

topics.title: Observability & Monitoring
topics.description: Micrometer metrics, OpenTelemetry tracing, health checks, and building observable production systems.

topics.title: Java Future Roadmap
topics.description: Project Valhalla (value types), Project Babylon (GPU compute), string templates, and staying current with OpenJDK.
